sections.h2: When Is Magento the Right Platform?

paragraphs.text: Magento is an open-source ecommerce platform that Adobe acquired in 2018. It comes in two editions: Magento Open Source, which is free to use, and Adobe Commerce, Adobe's paid edition with extra business features, support and cloud hosting options.

paragraphs.html: Is Magento good for large catalogues? Yes, it is one of its main strengths. Magento handles tens of thousands of products, layered navigation, multiple warehouses, several stores from one admin and detailed customer group pricing. If your catalogue is small and your needs are simple, we will tell you honestly that another platform may cost less to run.

sections.h2: What Magento Services Does Teknoppy Offer?

items.title: Magento 2 Development
items.text: Magento 2 development covers new stores built from the ground up: catalogue structure, product attributes, search, checkout, shipping rules, tax settings and payment options. Custom Magento development adds features your business needs that standard modules do not cover.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Development
items.text: Adobe Commerce development suits larger brands that need Adobe's advanced B2B tools, content staging, customer segmentation and official support. We help you decide whether the paid edition is worth it for your business before you commit. Adobe sets licence pricing according to business size and sales, so we compare that cost against the features you would actually use.

items.title: Magento B2B Ecommerce Development
items.text: Magento B2B ecommerce development gives trade buyers their own experience: company accounts with several users, customer-specific price lists, quick order by SKU, quote requests and credit limits. Sales teams spend less time on phone orders, and buyers can reorder in minutes. Each trade buyer sees only their own catalogue, prices and order history after logging in.

items.title: Magento Extension Development
items.text: Magento extension development builds custom modules for features such as special pricing logic, delivery slot rules or integration with your warehouse software. Every extension is version-controlled, documented and tested before release.

items.title: Magento Hyva Theme Development
items.text: Magento Hyva theme development replaces Magento's older, heavy front end with Hyvä (often written Hyva), a modern lightweight theme. Pages load faster, mobile shoppers see products sooner, and the front end is easier for developers to change.

items.title: Magento ERP Integration
items.text: Magento ERP integration connects your store to your accounting, inventory or ERP system, so stock, prices, orders and invoices stay in sync without manual entry. We plan each integration around the system you already use, and we document every data flow.

paragraphs.text: Typical Magento projects include building material and hardware catalogues with thousands of SKUs, auto parts stores with vehicle-based search, pharmacy and wellness stores with strict product data, fashion retailers with many size and colour variants, and industrial suppliers that sell to trade buyers on credit. Most share three needs: fast search across a large catalogue, accurate stock and flexible pricing by customer group.

sections.h2: Magento Upgrades, Speed and Ongoing Care

paragraphs.text: Magento 1 reached its end of life in June 2020, and older Magento 2 versions also stop receiving security patches over time. Running an unsupported version exposes customer data and payment pages to known risks.

Our Magento 2 upgrade services move your store to a supported release in planned stages. Every upgrade runs on a staging copy first, with extensions checked and replaced where needed, and goes live at a quiet time. We also remove extensions you no longer use, which reduces both risk and maintenance time.

Magento performance optimization covers full-page caching, image optimisation, database clean-up, search configuration and the Hyva front end. Faster stores convert more visitors into buyers, especially on mobile.

As a Magento development company Kochi stores rely on for day-to-day running, we also offer Magento maintenance and support Kochi clients choose for security patches, extension updates, backups, monitoring and small improvements, with plans from Rs. 3,000 per month.

sections.h2: Magento Open Source vs Adobe Commerce

paragraphs.text: Magento open source vs Adobe Commerce comes down to budget and business needs. Magento Open Source is free to license and suits most retailers and many B2B sellers, with features added through extensions. Adobe Commerce adds Adobe's native B2B suite, advanced marketing tools, cloud hosting and official support, but carries a significant yearly licence fee.
We recommend starting with Magento Open Source unless you need features only Adobe Commerce provides, and we explain the trade-off in writing during discovery.

paragraphs.text: How long does a Magento store take to build? Typical totals are 10 to 14 weeks for a retail store and 14 to 20 weeks for a B2B store with ERP integration.

sections.h2: How Much Does Magento Development Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: How much does Magento development cost in India? It depends on catalogue size, custom features, number of integrations, design complexity and whether you choose Magento Open Source or Adobe Commerce. Hosting for Magento also costs more than for simple platforms, because it needs stronger servers.
Every project is quoted after discovery. Each quote from our Magento development company Kochi office is fixed for the agreed scope and lists exactly what is included.

items.a: For large catalogues, B2B selling and complex integrations, yes. Magento remains one of the most flexible ecommerce platforms available. For small stores with simple needs, a lighter platform usually costs less to run.

items.q: Can Teknoppy take over an existing Magento store?
items.a: Yes. We begin with a Magento code audit and a written report, fix urgent security and stability issues first, then plan upgrades and improvements. Your store keeps trading throughout.

items.q: Can Magento handle Arabic and English?
items.a: Yes. Magento supports separate store views for each language, right-to-left layouts for Arabic, and different currencies, prices and shipping rules for each region, all managed from one admin.

items.q: How do I choose a Magento development company Kochi businesses can trust?
items.a: Check that developers are in-house, ask for live stores and references, and ask how the team handles upgrades, security patches and integrations. A reliable partner gives a fixed written scope and documents every custom module.

items.q: Do I own my Magento store and its code?
items.a: Yes. You own the store, the data and all custom code we write. We hand over repository access, documentation and admin credentials at launch.
